name: Gasteroids
description: Birds Nest Fungi, Earthballs, Earthstars, Puffballs, and Stinkhorns
comments: The term "gasteroid" refers to an informal, polyphyletic grouping of fungi whose classification is based on the shared characteristic of having their spores develop internally within a closed fruiting body (gasterothecium), rather than a monophyletic taxonomic group with a single common ancestor.
